name: Kahoku (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kahoku town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing the character 河.
history: Municipal flag of Kahoku, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1957.

features.role: Kahoku town emblem — a broken ring enclosing the character 河
